what: Precision audit of the auto label heuristics (pseudolife_memory/memory/labels.py) against the live bank; counts and hand verdicts only, no bank text committed.
method: All 215 fact hits of a deliberately LOOSE prototype rule (strong deontic | rule framing | never/always/do-not imperative anywhere | attribute name in {rule,constraint,policy,requirement,invariant,discipline}; value <= 400 chars) were hand-labelled genuine-rule vs descriptive by the implementing session (137 genuine). Each variant below is scored as the fraction of ITS hits judged genuine; every shipped hit lies inside the audited set.

authority_heuristic.gate: same 400-char rule-sized gate as distortion_tolerance (added after review; ungated it fired quoted on 26/836 entries)

blast_radius_note: No backfill ships: existing rows stay NULL. These counts are what a hypothetical auto-labelling of the existing bank WOULD pin.
